body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> DYMO demonstrated its new compact discpainter to label CD or DVD easily during CES 2008 Unveiled NY Press Preview. Featuring its patented ‘radialpint technology’ to print while the disc spins, this discpainter can print 600 dpi directly onto a CD/DVD in about 1 minute according to the company.
It works with both PC and Mac and you can print images directly from Photoshop while the discpainter comes with Discus for DYMO software.
